surface_verification.justification: The bug (white-on-white phase-description text, Sven screenshot report) is a real-rendered-CSS defect that jsdom's class/token fence (on-photo-legibility.test.ts) cannot itself prove fixed — it only proves the container carries the reset class, not that the reset actually yields a legible color pairing at runtime. This E2E spec drives the real New-Project wizard flow in a real Chromium (client/e2e/isolated-stack.mjs) to the plan-card step and asserts the rendered contrast ratio between the description text's computed color and its container's computed background clears WCAG AA (4.5:1) — the only real-browser coverage of this wizard screen (no visual baseline in e2e/visual/05-wizard.spec.ts reaches past step 1).
